title: Morning build
style: Natural window light, muted warm palette, 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, no on-screen text.

shots.prompt: Slow dolly-in on an open laptop on an oak desk at dawn; the screen shows scrolling terminal output. Soft keyboard clicks and distant birdsong.
Close-up, static: a hand sets a ceramic mug of coffee beside the laptop, steam rising. The clink of the mug on wood.
The camera tilts up from the desk to a tall window as sunlight spills across the room. A low, warm ambient hum.
